summary: Set AI policies, assign accountability, and oversee privacy risk. Explore the executive course and practical governance outputs.
lede: Responsible AI governance helps board members and executives oversee AI use, accountability, and data privacy. The training is for senior decision-makers and risk, legal, and compliance leaders who need to translate oversight into practice by setting acceptable-use rules, assigning owners, assessing use cases, and defining governance measures for board reporting. It also covers privacy review workflows and risk indicators, using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, and NIST Privacy Framework as reference points.
audienceIntro: This programme is designed for senior decision-makers responsible for setting AI direction, approving data use, and overseeing organizational risk. It is suitable for leaders who need to connect AI adoption with privacy safeguards, clear accountability, and board-level reporting.
prerequisites: No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with organizational decision-making, risk oversight, data privacy, or AI use cases will help you apply the exercises; advanced AI risk and privacy topics are introduced at conceptual or operational-application level, not technical implementation level.
